plan: Since this is a single-round auction and my value is $13, I need to bid strategically to maximize profit. I will bid slightly above what I estimate the other bidders might offer, while still ensuring a positive expected value. Given the possible range of values ($0-$20), a bid around $7.50 seems reasonable. This balances the chance of winning with the potential cost (second-highest bid).

This is round 1, so there's no history to learn from. My value is $11. To maximize profit, I need to bid slightly above what I expect the second-highest bid to be, but below my value. Assuming bidders bid somewhat randomly, I will bid $6.50. This is a conservative bid, aiming to win against potentially low bids while minimizing my payment.

This is the first and only round. My value is $12. I want to win if the second highest bid is less than $12. A conservative approach is to bid slightly above the midpoint of my value and zero, which is $6. However, since this is the only round, I want to be more aggressive. I'll bid $10.1. This has a good chance of winning while still leaving room for profit if my value is significantly higher than others.
